in_sanskrit.name: श्याम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is dark, blue-black, dusky, tawny. This is a name for Lord Krishna, who is often depicted as having a dark complexion.

in_tamil.name: சியம்
in_tamil.meaning: சிவன் இல்லாத மகன், அறக்கம் இல்லாத வருக்கல்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The man without Lord Shiva, the one without auspiciousness.

in_marathi.name: Shyam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shyam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shyam is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shyamah' which means 'dark' or 'blue'. In Hinduism, Shyam is a name of Lord Krishna, who is considered as the 'God of Gods'. The name represents the divine power and is believed to bring prosperity, happiness and good fortune.
